g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Pear body precedes stem, carrot root precedes crown branches, and duplicate dots are omitted at shared junctions. Cheese body and holes remain separated. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Pear, carrot root and cheese surfaces lower grey; outer contours, stem, crown and cheese hole boundaries higher black. Cheese hole interiors white unraised. No calibrated-height or material claim.
